title: Personal Loans Late History and Credit Builder Accounts Goodwill Credits
content:
The goodwill share applied to a Credit Builder late fee grows when the borrower holds a Larkspur personal loan, more so when the borrower's personal loans carry no recent late fee. The loans are the borrower's Personal Loans, read from the loan records (status) and the personal-loan ledger (late-fee entries and their dates).

## Personal Loans test

A borrower who holds a Larkspur personal loan in active status with no late fee charged on any Larkspur personal loan in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a line dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them) adds the clean-loan addition; one who holds such a loan with one or more such late fees adds the loan addition; a borrower with no active Larkspur personal loan adds nothing for a loan.

The late fees counted are those on any of the borrower's Personal Loans, active or not.

| Active Personal Loans loan | Personal-loan late fees in the 12 months | Added to the goodwill share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | clean-loan addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| yes | one or more | loan addition: 0.02 (2 percentage points) |
| no | any | nothing |

## Questions the rule answers

**A borrower holds an active personal loan, and a late fee was charged 13 months ago on an earlier personal loan that is now closed. Which addition applies?** The clean-loan addition of 5 percentage points: no personal-loan late fee falls in the 12 whole calendar months before today.

**The same borrower's earlier late fee was charged 11 months ago instead. Which addition applies?** The loan addition of 2 percentage points: a late fee on any Larkspur personal loan counts, active or not.
